title: Fix Wish bouquet Select empty value crash and preserve null bouquet submit behavior

requirements.summary: Remove empty-string SelectItem values from bouquet dropdown on CreateWishPage/EditWishPage while preserving placeholder and a user-visible 'No bouquet' option.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting the Create Wish page does not show the error banner and does not throw a Radix/Shadcn Select error in the browser console.
Visiting the Edit Wish page does not show the error banner and does not throw a Radix/Shadcn Select error in the browser console.
The bouquet dropdown still supports: (a) selecting a bouquet, and (b) selecting 'No bouquet' (or clearing the selection) so the wish is saved with bouquetId = null.
The Select placeholder "Select a bouquet (optional)" is displayed when no bouquet is selected.

file_operations.description: Add a small shared helper for bouquet Select values (e.g., a non-empty NO_BOUQUET sentinel value plus mapping helpers) so no SelectItem uses value="" while still allowing the Select to display placeholder when cleared.

Update bouquet attachment dropdown to use the shadcn-ui Select component without any SelectItem value="" by introducing a non-empty sentinel for the 'No bouquet' row and mapping Select.onValueChange to clear the state (set to "") so the SelectValue placeholder renders. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure create/edit wish submission converts bouquet selection safely and sends bouquetId: null when cleared/No bouquet is chosen, avoiding BigInt conversion on sentinel values.
acceptanceCriteria: Creating a wish with no bouquet succeeds and persists bouquetId as null.
Editing an existing wish to remove an attached bouquet succeeds and persists bouquetId as null.
No BigInt conversion errors occur when submitting the form with 'No bouquet' selected/cleared.

file_operations.description: Include/adjust a helper that converts the bouquet Select string value into the submit-ready type (bigint | null), ensuring sentinel/empty values map to null and only numeric strings are converted to BigInt.

Update wish submit payload handling to derive bouquetId via the shared helper so that cleared/No bouquet selection sends bouquetId: null and never attempts BigInt conversion on a sentinel/non-numeric value.
